description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class `CustomerOptionsSetController` that manages customer option set entities in an e-commerce application. It includes request handling methods for listing, saving, deleting, and updating customer option sets, with annotations for security and request mapping. The class interacts with various service components to perform business logic related to customer options and their associations, creating endpoints for admin operations on customer options within the web application.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsSetController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations and UI interactions for customer option sets in an admin web interface.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the list of customer options and option values, initializing the model with data for display.

methods.name: saveOptionSet
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a customer option set, performs validation and checks for existing associations.

methods.name: pageOptionsSet
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to fetch paginated customer option set data in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOptionSet
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to delete a specific customer option set based on its ID.

methods.name: updateOrder
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to update the order (sort order) of a customer option set.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set the current menu and active items for UI rendering.
